items.question: Trong câu "A BA is not a tester, but the BA plays a decisive part in ensuring the product is right.", từ "decisive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA is not a tester, but the BA plays a decisive part in ensuring the product is right.", what does "decisive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: decisive /dɪˈsaɪ.sɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính quyết định. "A decisive part" = vai trò quyết định kết quả. Nghĩa khác: a decisive leader (người lãnh đạo quả quyết).
items.explanationEn: decisive /dɪˈsaɪ.sɪv/ (adjective): crucial to the outcome. "A decisive part" strongly shapes the result. Other sense: a decisive (firm) leader.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA is not a tester, but the BA plays a decisive part in ensuring the product is right.", từ "play a part" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA is not a tester, but the BA plays a decisive part in ensuring the product is right.", what does "play a part" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: play a part /pleɪ ə pɑːt/ (cụm từ): đóng vai trò. "Play a (decisive) part in + V-ing" = đóng vai trò (quyết định) trong việc gì. Đồng nghĩa: play a role.
items.explanationEn: play a part /pleɪ ə pɑːt/ (phrase): to have a role. "Play a part in + -ing" means having a role in it. Synonym: play a role.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA is not a tester, but the BA plays a decisive part in ensuring the product is right.", từ "ensure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA is not a tester, but the BA plays a decisive part in ensuring the product is right.", what does "ensure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ensure /ɪnˈʃɔːr/ (động từ): bảo đảm. "Ensure that..." = bảo đảm rằng. Đừng nhầm với insure (mua bảo hiểm) và assure (trấn an).
items.explanationEn: ensure /ɪnˈʃɔːr/ (verb): to make certain. "Ensure that..." means make sure. Don't confuse it with insure (cover with insurance) or assure (reassure).

items.question: Trong câu "If a tester cannot write a test case from your requirement, a developer cannot build it correctly either.", từ "either" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a tester cannot write a test case from your requirement, a developer cannot build it correctly either.", what does "either" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: either /ˈaɪ.ðər/ (trạng từ): cũng (không). "Either" ở cuối câu phủ định = cũng không. Câu khẳng định dùng "too".
items.explanationEn: either /ˈaɪ.ðər/ (adverb): also, in a negative sentence. At the end of a negative sentence, "either" means also not. Positive sentences use "too".

items.question: Trong câu "When a tester reports a problem, helping determine whether it is a code defect or a case the requirement never covered.", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a tester reports a problem, helping determine whether it is a code defect or a case the requirement never covered.", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): bao quát, tính đến. "A case the requirement never covered" = trường hợp yêu cầu chưa tính đến. Danh từ: coverage.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to include or deal with. "A case the requirement never covered" was never addressed. Noun: coverage.

items.question: Trong câu "Preparing scenarios, supporting real users, and recording and classifying the results.", từ "scenario" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Preparing scenarios, supporting real users, and recording and classifying the results.", what does "scenario" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scenario /sɪˈnɑː.ri.əʊ/ (danh từ): kịch bản sử dụng. "UAT scenarios" = kịch bản người dùng thực hiện khi nghiệm thu. Cụm: worst-case scenario.
items.explanationEn: scenario /sɪˈnɑː.ri.əʊ/ (noun): a described sequence of actions. UAT scenarios describe tasks users perform during acceptance. Phrase: worst-case scenario.

items.question: Trong câu "The founding principle: system tests must derive from the REQUIREMENTS, not from the code.", từ "founding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The founding principle: system tests must derive from the REQUIREMENTS, not from the code.", what does "founding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: founding /ˈfaʊn.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): nền tảng, gốc rễ. "Founding principle" = nguyên tắc nền tảng. Nghĩa khác: founding member (thành viên sáng lập).
items.explanationEn: founding /ˈfaʊn.dɪŋ/ (adjective): basic, underlying. A founding principle underlies everything else. Other sense: a founding member.

items.question: Trong câu "The founding principle: system tests must derive from the REQUIREMENTS, not from the code.", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The founding principle: system tests must derive from the REQUIREMENTS, not from the code.", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): được suy ra từ. "Derive from" = bắt nguồn/được rút ra từ. Test phải suy ra từ yêu cầu, không phải từ code.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to come from a source. "Derive from" means originate in; tests come from requirements, not code.

items.question: Trong câu "you cannot detect functionality that is missing entirely.", từ "functionality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you cannot detect functionality that is missing entirely.", what does "functionality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: functionality /ˌfʌŋk.ʃənˈæl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): chức năng (của hệ thống). "Functionality that is missing" = chức năng bị thiếu hoàn toàn — chỉ phát hiện được khi test từ yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: functionality /ˌfʌŋk.ʃənˈæl.ə.ti/ (noun): what a system can do. Missing functionality can only be caught by testing from requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "you cannot detect functionality that is missing entirely.", từ "entirely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you cannot detect functionality that is missing entirely.", what does "entirely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪə.li/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn. "Missing entirely" = thiếu hoàn toàn. Tính từ: entire (toàn bộ).
items.explanationEn: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪə.li/ (adverb): completely. "Missing entirely" means completely absent. Adjective: entire.

items.question: Trong câu "Each acceptance criterion should produce at least one test case, usually more.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each acceptance criterion should produce at least one test case, usually more.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số ít: criterion; số nhiều: criteria. "Acceptance criterion" = một tiêu chí chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard for judging. Singular criterion, plural criteria. An acceptance criterion is one condition for acceptance.

items.question: Trong câu "Each acceptance criterion should produce at least one test case, usually more.", từ "produce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each acceptance criterion should produce at least one test case, usually more.", what does "produce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: produce /prəˈdjuːs/ (động từ): tạo ra, sinh ra. "Each AC should produce at least one test case" = mỗi AC sinh ra ít nhất một test case.
items.explanationEn: produce /prəˈdjuːs/ (verb): to give rise to. "Each AC should produce at least one test case" means give rise to one.

items.question: Trong câu "Each acceptance criterion should produce at least one test case, usually more.", từ "at least" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each acceptance criterion should produce at least one test case, usually more.", what does "at least" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at least /æt liːst/ (cụm từ): ít nhất. "At least one" = tối thiểu một. Trái nghĩa: at most (tối đa).
items.explanationEn: at least /æt liːst/ (phrase): no fewer than. "At least one" means one or more. Opposite: at most.

items.question: Trong câu "Boundary cases are the second most-omitted group after failure cases.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Boundary cases are the second most-omitted group after failure cases.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ sót. "Most-omitted" = hay bị bỏ sót nhất. Danh từ: omission. Đừng nhầm với emit (phát ra).
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. "Most-omitted" means most often left out. Noun: omission. Not to be confused with emit.

items.question: Trong câu "A great many defects sit exactly at the edge: a value equal to the threshold, an empty list, a list with exactly one element, the maximum permitted characters.", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A great many defects sit exactly at the edge: a value equal to the threshold, an empty list, a list with exactly one element, the maximum permitted characters.", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): ranh giới, biên. "Sit at the edge" = nằm ngay ranh giới. Cụm: edge case (trường hợp biên), competitive edge (lợi thế).
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): the limit of a range. "Sit at the edge" means right at a limit. Phrases: edge case, competitive edge.

items.question: Trong câu "A great many defects sit exactly at the edge: a value equal to the threshold, an empty list, a list with exactly one element, the maximum permitted characters.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A great many defects sit exactly at the edge: a value equal to the threshold, an empty list, a list with exactly one element, the maximum permitted characters.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a level that triggers a change
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng (giá trị). "Equal to the threshold" = bằng đúng ngưỡng — nơi lỗi hay xảy ra. Nghĩa đen: ngưỡng cửa.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (noun): a level that triggers a change. "Equal to the threshold" is exactly the trigger value, where bugs hide. Literal sense: a doorway sill.

items.question: Trong câu "A great many defects sit exactly at the edge: a value equal to the threshold, an empty list, a list with exactly one element, the maximum permitted characters.", từ "permitted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A great many defects sit exactly at the edge: a value equal to the threshold, an empty list, a list with exactly one element, the maximum permitted characters.", what does "permitted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: permitted /pəˈmɪt.ɪd/ (tính từ): được cho phép. "Maximum permitted characters" = số ký tự tối đa được phép. Động từ: permit.
items.explanationEn: permitted /pəˈmɪt.ɪd/ (adjective): allowed. "Maximum permitted characters" is the most allowed. Verb: permit.

items.question: Trong câu "A great many defects sit exactly at the edge: a value equal to the threshold, an empty list, a list with exactly one element, the maximum permitted characters.", từ "a great many" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A great many defects sit exactly at the edge: a value equal to the threshold, an empty list, a list with exactly one element, the maximum permitted characters.", what does "a great many" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: a great many /ə ɡreɪt ˈmen.i/ (cụm từ): rất nhiều. "A great many + danh từ số nhiều" = rất nhiều. Trang trọng hơn "a lot of".
items.explanationEn: a great many /ə ɡreɪt ˈmen.i/ (phrase): a large number of. "A great many + plural noun" means very many; more formal than "a lot of".

items.question: Trong câu "A product goes out of stock mid-flow; the payment gateway is unreachable; delivery details incomplete", từ "out of stock" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A product goes out of stock mid-flow; the payment gateway is unreachable; delivery details incomplete", what does "out of stock" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out of stock /aʊt əv stɒk/ (cụm từ): hết hàng. "Goes out of stock mid-flow" = hết hàng giữa chừng khi đang đặt. Trái nghĩa: in stock.
items.explanationEn: out of stock /aʊt əv stɒk/ (phrase): not available to sell. "Goes out of stock mid-flow" means it sells out mid-order. Opposite: in stock.

items.question: Trong câu "A product goes out of stock mid-flow; the payment gateway is unreachable; delivery details incomplete", từ "unreachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A product goes out of stock mid-flow; the payment gateway is unreachable; delivery details incomplete", what does "unreachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unreachable /ʌnˈriː.tʃə.bəl/ (tính từ): không kết nối được. "The payment gateway is unreachable" = cổng thanh toán không phản hồi, không kết nối được.
items.explanationEn: unreachable /ʌnˈriː.tʃə.bəl/ (adjective): cannot be contacted. "The payment gateway is unreachable" means it cannot be contacted.

items.question: Trong câu "It answers two questions instantly: which requirement is untested, and which test traces to no requirement.", từ "trace" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It answers two questions instantly: which requirement is untested, and which test traces to no requirement.", what does "trace" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to link back to a source
items.explanation: trace /treɪs/ (động từ): liên kết ngược về. "Test traces to a requirement" = test liên kết ngược về một yêu cầu. Danh từ: traceability.
items.explanationEn: trace /treɪs/ (verb): to link back to a source. "A test traces to a requirement" means it links back to one. Noun: traceability.

items.question: Trong câu "Order created in Pending Confirmation; stock decremented; confirmation email sent within 1 minute", từ "decrement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Order created in Pending Confirmation; stock decremented; confirmation email sent within 1 minute", what does "decrement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decrement /ˈdek.rə.ment/ (động từ): trừ bớt đi. "Stock decremented" = số tồn kho bị trừ đi. Trái nghĩa: increment (tăng thêm).
items.explanationEn: decrement /ˈdek.rə.ment/ (verb): to reduce by an amount. "Stock decremented" means the stock count went down. Opposite: increment.

items.question: Trong câu "For repetitive or quick checks, a checklist is far more efficient.", từ "repetitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For repetitive or quick checks, a checklist is far more efficient.", what does "repetitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: repetitive /rɪˈpet.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Repetitive checks" = các lần kiểm tra lặp lại, hợp dùng checklist. Động từ: repeat.
items.explanationEn: repetitive /rɪˈpet.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): done again and again. Repetitive checks are done over and over, so checklists fit. Verb: repeat.

items.question: Trong câu "For repetitive or quick checks, a checklist is far more efficient.", từ "efficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For repetitive or quick checks, a checklist is far more efficient.", what does "efficient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (tính từ): hiệu quả, đỡ tốn công. "Efficient" = ít tốn công/tài nguyên; "effective" = đạt được mục tiêu. Danh từ: efficiency.
items.explanationEn: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (adjective): achieving more with less effort. Efficient means little wasted effort; effective means it works. Noun: efficiency.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick regression checks before each release.", từ "regression" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick regression checks before each release.", what does "regression" (noun) mean?
options: sự hồi quy (lỗi cũ tái xuất)
items.explanation: regression /rɪˈɡreʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự hồi quy (lỗi cũ tái xuất). "Regression checks" = kiểm tra lại để chắc tính năng cũ không bị hỏng sau thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: regression /rɪˈɡreʃ.ən/ (noun): old features breaking again. Regression checks confirm old features still work after a change.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick regression checks before each release.", từ "release" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick regression checks before each release.", what does "release" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: release /rɪˈliːs/ (danh từ): bản phát hành. "Before each release" = trước mỗi lần phát hành. Cụm: release notes (ghi chú phát hành).
items.explanationEn: release /rɪˈliːs/ (noun): a new version made available. "Before each release" means before each version ships. Phrase: release notes.

items.question: Trong câu "Interface consistency checks across many screens.", từ "consistency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Interface consistency checks across many screens.", what does "consistency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consistency /kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (danh từ): tính nhất quán. "Interface consistency" = giao diện đồng nhất giữa các màn hình. Tính từ: consistent.
items.explanationEn: consistency /kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (noun): being the same throughout. "Interface consistency" means screens look and behave alike. Adjective: consistent.

items.question: Trong câu "Accessibility checks — every image has alt text, every field has a label, keyboard navigation works.", từ "accessibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accessibility checks — every image has alt text, every field has a label, keyboard navigation works.", what does "accessibility" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng truy cập mạng (tốc độ)
mức độ bảo mật dữ liệu
mức độ phổ biến trên thị trường
khả năng tiếp cận (cho người khuyết tật)
items.explanation: accessibility /əkˌses.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng tiếp cận (cho người khuyết tật). "Accessibility checks" = kiểm tra để người khiếm thị, dùng bàn phím... đều dùng được (viết tắt a11y).
items.explanationEn: accessibility /əkˌses.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): usability for people with disabilities. Accessibility checks make sure people with disabilities can use the product (short form: a11y).

items.question: Trong câu "Accessibility checks — every image has alt text, every field has a label, keyboard navigation works.", từ "navigation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accessibility checks — every image has alt text, every field has a label, keyboard navigation works.", what does "navigation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: navigation /ˌnæv.ɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự điều hướng. "Keyboard navigation" = di chuyển trong giao diện bằng bàn phím. Động từ: navigate.
items.explanationEn: navigation /ˌnæv.ɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): moving around an interface. "Keyboard navigation" means moving through the UI with keys. Verb: navigate.

items.question: Trong câu "The empty state displays correctly and suggests the next action", từ "suggest" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The empty state displays correctly and suggests the next action", what does "suggest" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suggest /səˈdʒest/ (động từ): gợi ý. Màn hình trống tốt nên "suggest the next action" = gợi ý bước tiếp theo. Danh từ: suggestion.
items.explanationEn: suggest /səˈdʒest/ (verb): to propose an idea. A good empty state suggests the next action. Noun: suggestion.

items.question: Trong câu "The loading state displays and does not hang forever on failure", từ "hang" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The loading state displays and does not hang forever on failure", what does "hang" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hang /hæŋ/ (động từ): bị treo (đứng im). "Hang forever" = bị treo mãi. Máy tính: the app hangs (ứng dụng bị treo). Cụm khác: hang out (đi chơi).
items.explanationEn: hang /hæŋ/ (verb): to stop responding. "Hang forever" means freeze indefinitely. Other phrase: hang out (spend time).

items.question: Trong câu "Large data (a thousand rows) remains usable — pagination or filtering exists", từ "pagination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Large data (a thousand rows) remains usable — pagination or filtering exists", what does "pagination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pagination /ˌpædʒ.ɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân trang. "Pagination" = chia danh sách dài thành nhiều trang để vẫn dùng được với dữ liệu lớn.
items.explanationEn: pagination /ˌpædʒ.ɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): splitting content into pages. Pagination splits long lists into pages so large data stays usable.

items.question: Trong câu "Large data (a thousand rows) remains usable — pagination or filtering exists", từ "usable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Large data (a thousand rows) remains usable — pagination or filtering exists", what does "usable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: usable /ˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): vẫn dùng được. "Remains usable" = vẫn sử dụng được. Danh từ: usability (tính dễ dùng).
items.explanationEn: usable /ˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be used. "Remains usable" means people can still use it. Noun: usability.

items.question: Trong câu "Destructive actions require confirmation", từ "destructive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Destructive actions require confirmation", what does "destructive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: destructive /dɪˈstrʌk.tɪv/ (tính từ): gây mất dữ liệu. "Destructive actions" = thao tác xóa/không hoàn tác được, nên cần xác nhận. Trái nghĩa: constructive.
items.explanationEn: destructive /dɪˈstrʌk.tɪv/ (adjective): that deletes or destroys. Destructive actions delete or can't be undone, so they need confirmation. Opposite: constructive.

items.question: Trong câu "Navigating back midway does not lose entered data unintentionally", từ "midway" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Navigating back midway does not lose entered data unintentionally", what does "midway" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: midway /ˌmɪdˈweɪ/ (trạng từ): giữa chừng. "Navigating back midway" = quay lại khi đang làm dở. Đồng nghĩa: halfway.
items.explanationEn: midway /ˌmɪdˈweɪ/ (adverb): halfway through. "Navigating back midway" means leaving part-way through. Synonym: halfway.

items.question: Trong câu "Navigating back midway does not lose entered data unintentionally", từ "unintentionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Navigating back midway does not lose entered data unintentionally", what does "unintentionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: unintentionally /ˌʌn.ɪnˈten.ʃən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): một cách vô ý. "Lose data unintentionally" = vô tình mất dữ liệu. Trái nghĩa: intentionally (cố ý).
items.explanationEn: unintentionally /ˌʌn.ɪnˈten.ʃən.əl.i/ (adverb): without meaning to. "Lose data unintentionally" means by accident. Opposite: intentionally.

items.question: Trong câu "This checklist applies to EVERY screen, so it belongs to the definition of done rather than to any one story's acceptance criteria.", từ "definition of done" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This checklist applies to EVERY screen, so it belongs to the definition of done rather than to any one story's acceptance criteria.", what does "definition of done" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: definition of done /ˌdef.ɪˈnɪʃ.ən əv dʌn/ (cụm từ): tiêu chuẩn hoàn thành chung. "Definition of done" (DoD) = bộ tiêu chí chung áp dụng cho mọi story; khác với AC riêng từng story.
items.explanationEn: definition of done /ˌdef.ɪˈnɪʃ.ən əv dʌn/ (phrase): the team's shared completion standard. The definition of done (DoD) applies to every story, unlike a single story's AC.

items.question: Trong câu "This checklist applies to EVERY screen, so it belongs to the definition of done rather than to any one story's acceptance criteria.", từ "belong to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This checklist applies to EVERY screen, so it belongs to the definition of done rather than to any one story's acceptance criteria.", what does "belong to" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to have its proper place in
items.explanation: belong to /bɪˈlɒŋ tuː/ (cụm từ): thuộc về (chỗ nào). "It belongs to the definition of done" = nó nên nằm trong DoD. Nghĩa khác: this car belongs to me (của tôi).
items.explanationEn: belong to /bɪˈlɒŋ tuː/ (phrase): to have its proper place in. "It belongs to the definition of done" means that is where it goes. Other sense: to be owned by.

items.question: Trong câu "UAT (user acceptance testing) is where real users confirm the system meets their business need.", từ "confirm" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UAT (user acceptance testing) is where real users confirm the system meets their business need.", what does "confirm" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (động từ): xác nhận. Trong UAT, người dùng thật "confirm" (xác nhận) hệ thống đáp ứng nhu cầu. Danh từ: confirmation.
items.explanationEn: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (verb): to establish as true. In UAT, real users confirm the system serves their need. Noun: confirmation.

items.question: Trong câu "UAT finds what the specification missed: the real process differing from the description, exception cases nobody considered, actions that are technically correct but so inconvenient they are unusable.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UAT finds what the specification missed: the real process differing from the description, exception cases nobody considered, actions that are technically correct but so inconvenient they are unusable.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (động từ): khác với. "The real process differing from the description" = quy trình thực khác mô tả. Cụm: differ from.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differing from the description" means not matching it. Pattern: differ from.

items.question: Trong câu "UAT finds what the specification missed: the real process differing from the description, exception cases nobody considered, actions that are technically correct but so inconvenient they are unusable.", từ "inconvenient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UAT finds what the specification missed: the real process differing from the description, exception cases nobody considered, actions that are technically correct but so inconvenient they are unusable.", what does "inconvenient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inconvenient /ˌɪn.kənˈviː.ni.ənt/ (tính từ): bất tiện. Thao tác đúng kỹ thuật nhưng quá bất tiện đến mức không dùng được — UAT phát hiện loại này.
items.explanationEn: inconvenient /ˌɪn.kənˈviː.ni.ənt/ (adjective): causing trouble or effort. UAT catches actions that are technically correct but too inconvenient to use.

items.question: Trong câu "If UAT surfaces mostly basic technical defects, system testing was not done well — and you are wasting valuable business users' time.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If UAT surfaces mostly basic technical defects, system testing was not done well — and you are wasting valuable business users' time.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to rise to the water's top
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "UAT surfaces defects" = UAT làm lộ ra lỗi. Danh từ "surface" = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to bring to light. "UAT surfaces defects" means it reveals them. As a noun, surface means the outside layer.

items.question: Trong câu "If UAT surfaces mostly basic technical defects, system testing was not done well — and you are wasting valuable business users' time.", từ "waste" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If UAT surfaces mostly basic technical defects, system testing was not done well — and you are wasting valuable business users' time.", what does "waste" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: waste /weɪst/ (động từ): lãng phí. "Waste someone's time" = làm mất thời gian của ai. Danh từ: waste (rác thải, sự lãng phí).
items.explanationEn: waste /weɪst/ (verb): to use carelessly. "Waste someone's time" means using it for nothing. Noun: waste.

items.question: Trong câu "Include both experts and newcomers, since they hit different problems.", từ "newcomer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Include both experts and newcomers, since they hit different problems.", what does "newcomer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: newcomer /ˈnjuːˌkʌm.ər/ (danh từ): người mới. Nên mời cả chuyên gia lẫn "newcomers" (người mới) vì họ gặp vấn đề khác nhau. Đồng nghĩa: novice.
items.explanationEn: newcomer /ˈnjuːˌkʌm.ər/ (noun): someone recently arrived. Invite both experts and newcomers since they struggle differently. Synonym: novice.

items.question: Trong câu "Fake data hides problems from users.", từ "fake" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fake data hides problems from users.", what does "fake" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fake /feɪk/ (tính từ): giả, không có thật. "Fake data" = dữ liệu giả, che giấu vấn đề. Cụm: fake news. Trái nghĩa: real, genuine.
items.explanationEn: fake /feɪk/ (adjective): not real. Fake data hides real problems. Phrase: fake news. Opposite: real, genuine.

items.question: Trong câu "Ensure a stable environment.", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ensure a stable environment.", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (tính từ): ổn định. "A stable environment" = môi trường chạy ổn định. Danh từ "stable" là chuồng ngựa. Danh từ liên quan: stability.
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (adjective): not likely to fail. A stable environment won't crash. As a noun, a stable houses horses. Related: stability.

items.question: Trong câu "Nothing kills a UAT session faster than the system crashing midway.", từ "crash" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nothing kills a UAT session faster than the system crashing midway.", what does "crash" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: crash /kræʃ/ (động từ): bị sập (hệ thống). "The system crashing" = hệ thống bị sập. Nghĩa khác: car crash, market crash.
items.explanationEn: crash /kræʃ/ (verb): to stop working suddenly. "The system crashing" means it fails suddenly. Other senses: a car crash, a market crash.

items.question: Trong câu "Give the task then watch in silence.", từ "in silence" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Give the task then watch in silence.", what does "in silence" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in silence /ɪn ˈsaɪ.ləns/ (cụm từ): trong im lặng. "Watch in silence" = quan sát, không nói gì để không dẫn dắt người dùng.
items.explanationEn: in silence /ɪn ˈsaɪ.ləns/ (phrase): without speaking. "Watch in silence" means observing without prompting the user.

items.question: Trong câu "Wherever they pause or go wrong is where the problem is.", từ "go wrong" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wherever they pause or go wrong is where the problem is.", what does "go wrong" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: go wrong /ɡəʊ rɒŋ/ (cụm từ): làm sai, gặp trục trặc. "Where they go wrong" = chỗ họ thao tác sai — chính là nơi có vấn đề. Cụm: something went wrong.
items.explanationEn: go wrong /ɡəʊ rɒŋ/ (phrase): to make a mistake. "Where they go wrong" marks where the problem is. Phrase: something went wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not explain when they get stuck.", từ "get stuck" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not explain when they get stuck.", what does "get stuck" (phrase) mean?
options: bị bí, không làm tiếp được
items.explanation: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (cụm từ): bị bí, không làm tiếp được. "Get stuck" = bị bí, không biết làm gì tiếp. Nghĩa đen: bị mắc kẹt.
items.explanationEn: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (phrase): to be unable to continue. "Get stuck" means unable to progress. Literal sense: to be physically trapped.

items.question: Trong câu "Record the PROBLEM, not the solution they propose.", từ "propose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record the PROBLEM, not the solution they propose.", what does "propose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (động từ): đề xuất. "The solution they propose" = giải pháp họ đề xuất. Danh từ: proposal. Nghĩa khác: propose to someone (cầu hôn).
items.explanationEn: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (verb): to put forward. "The solution they propose" is what they suggest. Noun: proposal. Other sense: to propose marriage.

items.question: Trong câu "Classify the results: code defect / missed requirement / new requirement / misunderstanding needing training.", từ "misunderstanding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Classify the results: code defect / missed requirement / new requirement / misunderstanding needing training.", what does "misunderstanding" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misunderstanding /ˌmɪs.ʌn.dəˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự hiểu nhầm. "Misunderstanding needing training" = người dùng hiểu sai cách dùng, cần đào tạo. Động từ: misunderstand.
items.explanationEn: misunderstanding /ˌmɪs.ʌn.dəˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (noun): a failure to understand. A misunderstanding needing training means the user used it wrongly. Verb: misunderstand.

items.question: Trong câu "Close the loop: tell participants which issues were addressed and which were not, with reasons.", từ "close the loop" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Close the loop: tell participants which issues were addressed and which were not, with reasons.", what does "close the loop" (phrase) mean?
options: phản hồi lại cho trọn vẹn
optionsEn: to follow up on the outcome
items.explanation: close the loop /kləʊz ðə luːp/ (cụm từ): phản hồi lại cho trọn vẹn. "Close the loop" = báo lại kết quả cho người đã góp ý. Cụm công sở phổ biến: let's close the loop on this.
items.explanationEn: close the loop /kləʊz ðə luːp/ (phrase): to follow up on the outcome. "Close the loop" means reporting back to those who gave input. Common at work: let's close the loop on this.

items.question: Trong câu "Close the loop: tell participants which issues were addressed and which were not, with reasons.", từ "address" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Close the loop: tell participants which issues were addressed and which were not, with reasons.", what does "address" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: address /əˈdres/ (động từ): xử lý, giải quyết. "Issues were addressed" = vấn đề đã được xử lý. Nghĩa khác: address the audience (phát biểu).
items.explanationEn: address /əˈdres/ (verb): to deal with. "Issues were addressed" means they were dealt with. Other sense: to address an audience.

items.question: Trong câu "Failing to report back to UAT participants is the error that kills collaboration.", từ "report back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Failing to report back to UAT participants is the error that kills collaboration.", what does "report back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: report back /rɪˈpɔːt bæk/ (cụm từ): báo lại kết quả. "Report back to participants" = báo lại cho người tham gia biết kết quả. Cụm: report back to your manager.
items.explanationEn: report back /rɪˈpɔːt bæk/ (phrase): to return with an update. "Report back to participants" means telling them what happened. Phrase: report back to your manager.

items.question: Trong câu "Failing to report back to UAT participants is the error that kills collaboration.", từ "collaboration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Failing to report back to UAT participants is the error that kills collaboration.", what does "collaboration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hợp tác. "Kill collaboration" = phá hỏng sự hợp tác. Nghĩa lịch sử: collaboration with the enemy (cộng tác với địch).
items.explanationEn: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): working together. "Kill collaboration" means destroy willingness to work together. Historical sense: helping an occupying enemy.

items.question: Trong câu "Next time you invite them, they will not come — because they believe their input leads nowhere.", từ "input" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Next time you invite them, they will not come — because they believe their input leads nowhere.", what does "input" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (danh từ): ý kiến đóng góp. "Their input" = ý kiến đóng góp của họ. Nghĩa kỹ thuật: user input (dữ liệu người dùng nhập).
items.explanationEn: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (noun): ideas or feedback given. "Their input" means their feedback. Technical sense: user input (data entered).

items.question: Trong câu "Next time you invite them, they will not come — because they believe their input leads nowhere.", từ "lead nowhere" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Next time you invite them, they will not come — because they believe their input leads nowhere.", what does "lead nowhere" (phrase) mean?
options: không đi đến kết quả gì
optionsEn: to not be in first place
items.explanation: lead nowhere /liːd ˈnəʊ.weər/ (cụm từ): không đi đến kết quả gì. "Their input leads nowhere" = góp ý của họ chẳng đem lại kết quả. Trái nghĩa: lead to change.
items.explanationEn: lead nowhere /liːd ˈnəʊ.weər/ (phrase): to produce no result. "Their input leads nowhere" means nothing comes of it. Opposite: lead to change.

items.question: Trong câu "Not everything raised in UAT is a defect to fix immediately.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not everything raised in UAT is a defect to fix immediately.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): nêu ra. "Everything raised in UAT" = mọi vấn đề được nêu ra trong UAT. Cụm: raise a question, raise a concern.
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to bring up. "Everything raised in UAT" means every point brought up. Phrases: raise a question, raise a concern.

items.question: Trong câu "The requirement never covered this case, and current behaviour is unacceptable", từ "unacceptable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The requirement never covered this case, and current behaviour is unacceptable", what does "unacceptable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unacceptable /ˌʌn.əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể chấp nhận. "Current behaviour is unacceptable" = hành vi hiện tại không chấp nhận được → yêu cầu bị sót.
items.explanationEn: unacceptable /ˌʌn.əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (adjective): not good enough to allow. "Current behaviour is unacceptable" signals a missed requirement.

items.question: Trong câu "Create a backlog item and prioritize it", từ "prioritize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Create a backlog item and prioritize it", what does "prioritize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prioritize /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (động từ): xếp thứ tự ưu tiên. "Prioritize it" = xếp mức ưu tiên cho mục backlog. Danh từ: priority. Anh-Anh viết prioritise.
items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (verb): to rank by importance. "Prioritize it" means rank it in the backlog. Noun: priority. British spelling: prioritise.

items.question: Trong câu "The system is correct, the user is unfamiliar", từ "unfamiliar" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system is correct, the user is unfamiliar", what does "unfamiliar" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unfamiliar /ˌʌn.fəˈmɪl.i.ər/ (tính từ): chưa quen. "The user is unfamiliar" = người dùng chưa quen hệ thống. Cụm: unfamiliar with.
items.explanationEn: unfamiliar /ˌʌn.fəˈmɪl.i.ər/ (adjective): not used to something. "The user is unfamiliar" means not yet used to the system. Pattern: unfamiliar with.

items.question: Trong câu "Add training or improve in-product guidance", từ "guidance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Add training or improve in-product guidance", what does "guidance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guidance /ˈɡaɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): sự hướng dẫn. "In-product guidance" = hướng dẫn ngay trong sản phẩm (tooltip, gợi ý). Động từ: guide.
items.explanationEn: guidance /ˈɡaɪ.dəns/ (noun): help and advice. In-product guidance means tips shown inside the product. Verb: guide.

items.question: Trong câu "It means elicitation and grooming did not cover exception cases well — something to improve for the next project, not merely a batch of defects to fix.", từ "grooming" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It means elicitation and grooming did not cover exception cases well — something to improve for the next project, not merely a batch of defects to fix.", what does "grooming" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: grooming /ˈɡruː.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự chuẩn bị backlog. "Backlog grooming" (nay hay gọi backlog refinement) = làm rõ, sắp xếp các mục backlog. Nghĩa gốc: chải chuốt.
items.explanationEn: grooming /ˈɡruː.mɪŋ/ (noun): refining backlog items. Backlog grooming (now usually called refinement) means clarifying and ordering items. Original sense: tidying one's appearance.

items.question: Trong câu "It means elicitation and grooming did not cover exception cases well — something to improve for the next project, not merely a batch of defects to fix.", từ "merely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It means elicitation and grooming did not cover exception cases well — something to improve for the next project, not merely a batch of defects to fix.", what does "merely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (trạng từ): chỉ đơn thuần. "Not merely a batch of defects" = không chỉ đơn thuần là một loạt lỗi. Đồng nghĩa: just, only.
items.explanationEn: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (adverb): only, simply. "Not merely a batch of defects" means more than just bugs. Synonyms: just, only.

items.question: Trong câu "It means elicitation and grooming did not cover exception cases well — something to improve for the next project, not merely a batch of defects to fix.", từ "batch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It means elicitation and grooming did not cover exception cases well — something to improve for the next project, not merely a batch of defects to fix.", what does "batch" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: batch /bætʃ/ (danh từ): một loạt, một lô. "A batch of defects" = một loạt lỗi. Cụm: batch processing (xử lý theo lô).
items.explanationEn: batch /bætʃ/ (noun): a group handled together. "A batch of defects" is a group of them. Phrase: batch processing.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA's testing role is making requirements verifiable, reviewing coverage, classifying issues, and running UAT.", từ "verifiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA's testing role is making requirements verifiable, reviewing coverage, classifying issues, and running UAT.", what does "verifiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: verifiable /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể kiểm chứng. "Making requirements verifiable" = viết yêu cầu sao cho kiểm thử được. Động từ: verify.
items.explanationEn: verifiable /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be checked. "Making requirements verifiable" means they can be tested. Verb: verify.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA's testing role is making requirements verifiable, reviewing coverage, classifying issues, and running UAT.", từ "coverage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA's testing role is making requirements verifiable, reviewing coverage, classifying issues, and running UAT.", what does "coverage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: coverage /ˈkʌv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): độ bao phủ (của test). "Reviewing coverage" = kiểm tra xem yêu cầu nào đã có test. Cụm: test coverage.
items.explanationEn: coverage /ˈkʌv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (noun): how much is tested. "Reviewing coverage" checks which requirements have tests. Phrase: test coverage.

items.question: Trong câu "If UAT surfaces mostly basic defects, system testing was inadequate and you are wasting users' time.", từ "inadequate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If UAT surfaces mostly basic defects, system testing was inadequate and you are wasting users' time.", what does "inadequate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inadequate /ɪˈnæd.ɪ.kwət/ (tính từ): không đạt yêu cầu. "Testing was inadequate" = kiểm thử chưa đủ tốt. Trái nghĩa: adequate.
items.explanationEn: inadequate /ɪˈnæd.ɪ.kwət/ (adjective): not good enough. "Testing was inadequate" means it fell short. Opposite: adequate.

items.question: Trong câu "Fake data hides problems from users — use realistic, masked data.", từ "mask" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fake data hides problems from users — use realistic, masked data.", what does "mask" (verb) mean?
options: che giấu thông tin nhạy cảm
items.explanation: mask /mɑːsk/ (động từ): che giấu thông tin nhạy cảm. "Masked data" = dữ liệu thật đã bị che thông tin nhạy cảm (tên, số thẻ). Cụm: data masking.
items.explanationEn: mask /mɑːsk/ (verb): to hide sensitive values. "Masked data" is real data with sensitive values hidden. Phrase: data masking.

items.question: Trong câu "System tests must derive from requirements, not code — otherwise you cannot detect functionality that is missing entirely.", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "System tests must derive from requirements, not code — otherwise you cannot detect functionality that is missing entirely.", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌð.ə.waɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. "Otherwise" = nếu không (làm vậy) thì. Nghĩa khác: unless otherwise stated (trừ khi nói khác).
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌð.ə.waɪz/ (adverb): if not. "Otherwise" means if that is not done. Other sense: unless otherwise stated.
